notes: Total 60 as published; the 'red stuff33' header counts 33 but the lines total 35. Section labels ('starting crap6', 'location4', 'character12', 'green crap1', 'blue2', 'red stuff33') are headers, not cards.

Filed as general: Decipher's Deck Designs already published Lapointe's 2000 Worlds Light deck ([[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe LS]]). This post is the same Mind What You Have Learned deck with a few different slots (here 2 'grabbler' and 2 Projection Of A Skywalker; the Deck Designs list has Sorry About The Mess and Surprise Assault instead).

Starting cards as posted under 'starting crap6': the Objective, Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted 'heading for the boat'), Insurrection, Wise Advice and Your Insight Serves You Well. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set; Wise Advice and Your Insight Serves You Well are the older Effects, not the later Defensive Shields.
'grabbler x2' is UNKNOWN (no card of that name in 2000; Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant card, August 2001); shown as posted and left out of GEMP.

Posted 'jedi luke, the pimp' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'obi w stick' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'leia w stick' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'luke beetstick' Luke's Lightsaber; 'super duper falcon' Millennium Falcon; 'captain solo' Captain Han Solo; 'endordb' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Light); 'ccdb' Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay); 'home1db' Home One: Docking Bay; 'yoda's house' Dagobah: Yoda's Hut; 'frozen asset' Frozen Assets.
player_note: The post's description says: "the deck i use in day 3, 2-1 losing because of a meta choice:(" (2000 Decipher World Championship Day 3, 7 October 2000). Decipher's Deck Designs published his Worlds Light list: [[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe LS]].
